not_acquired_layers.evidence: OWDA primary paper Supplementary Fig. S11 publishes calibration/validation maps, but NOAA directory exposes owda.nc, owda.txt and coordinate/readme files only; no skill raster/table was found.
not_acquired_layers.required_action: obtain author-supplied numeric S11 skill grid or implement a documented digitization with quantified raster error; do not infer skill from PDSI coverage

not_acquired_layers.evidence: NOAA directory exposes NADAv2-2008.nc, text and map archives but no calibration/verification skill field.
not_acquired_layers.required_action: obtain numeric skill grid from Cook et al. supplementary material or retain regional-only uncertainty

not_acquired_layers.evidence: NOAA SADA directory exposes SADA_t.nc, SADA_tplus1.nc and metadata only; no skill raster/table.
not_acquired_layers.required_action: obtain numeric validation fields from Morales et al. supplementary material; post-1337 source remains validation-only

acceptance.reason: MADA skill data now exist as a source-backed partial layer. It cannot close global spatial uncertainty because OWDA, NADA and SADA numeric skill layers remain unavailable, and skill statistics do not convert hydroclimate proxies into crop yields.
